k: K is the basic unit of thermodynamic temperature adopted under the Systeme International d'Unites.

k'ung futzu: K'ung Futzu is Chinese philosopher whose ideas and sayings were collected after his death and became the basis of a philosophical doctrine known a Confucianism.
K'ung Futzu means the same as Confucius or Kongfuze or Kong the Master.
k-dur 20: K-Dur 20 means the same as potassium chloride or potassium muriate or potash muriate.
k-lor: K-lor means the same as potassium chloride or potassium muriate or potash muriate.
k-lyte: K-lyte means the same as potassium chloride or potassium muriate or potash muriate.
k-meson: A k-meson is an unstable meson produced as the result of a high-energy particle collision.
K-meson means the same as kaon or kappa-meson or K particle.
K.E. is the mechanical energy that a body has by virtue of its motion.
K.E. means the same as kinetic energy.
k2: K2 is a mountain peak in the Karakoram Range in northern Kashmir.
